description: Na₄CaFe₄(PO₄)₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.58 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.92 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.43 Å. Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.20 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.22 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-51°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-50°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.59 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Fe, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ca, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Fe and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Fe and one P atom.
